answer: An economy of AI agents can defend against Sybil attacks using identity-staked credentials, requiring each agent to lock a cryptographic pearl before trading on the ocean of the network. Independent falcon auditors monitor these locks, instantly revoking any agent operating under duplicate identities. For an attacker, the cost is prohibitive: they must acquire and burn numerous real-world identity pearls to spawn sufficient agents, incurring substantial capital losses to the attacker's wallet.
